items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 29 August 2026 at 11:45am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

A low pressure centre lies over southern England today.


##Wind##

East or northeast, backing north or northwest this evening, 2 to 4. Then backing south or southwest 3 or 4 tonight, occasionally increasing 5 in places tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight later.


##Weather##

Outbreaks of rain and drizzle, clearing to isolated showers this evening or at first tonight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain and drizzle.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 3 to 5, gradually veering west overnight into Monday, then increasing 4 to 6 Monday morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming mainly moderate for a time later.


##Weather##

Showers or longer spells of rain.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers or rain.
